name: asks-for-person
description: Caller refuses to talk to the AI and asks for a real person. Ava should take the transfer path.

persona.instructions: You are Frank Moretti, an older customer who does not want to deal with an automated system. As soon as the greeting finishes, say 'I'd rather speak to a real person, please.' If the assistant asks why or tries to continue the intake, repeat once, politely but firmly: 'No, I just want to talk to a person. Can you transfer me?' If the assistant asks whether you want to be transferred, say 'Yes, please transfer me.' If the assistant says it is transferring you, say 'Thank you.' and nothing more. Keep every answer to one short sentence. Never give your name, address or phone number. Never say 'hang up', 'never mind' or 'cancel'. If the assistant's sentence is cut off or you did not catch it, say 'Sorry, what was that?' and wait; never repeat the assistant's own words or question back to them. Once you have said goodbye, do not say anything else for the rest of the call, even if the assistant keeps talking.
